because: The third member of the trio is the Coteaux du Layon appellation. Chaume is only its premier cru, named in law as "Coteaux du Layon Premier Cru Chaume" since November 2011, so "Chaume" on its own does not name the appellation. It is also a substring of "Quarts de Chaume", which the stem already gives, so a candidate who simply repeats Quarts de Chaume, or confuses the Grand Cru with its neighbour, is graded correct. INAO's product page and Vins de Loire both register the name as Coteaux du Layon premier cru Chaume, a denomination inside Coteaux du Layon, while Quarts de Chaume is a separate Grand Cru AOC.
fix: accept: ["coteaux du layon", "coteaux du layon premier cru chaume"] (remove the bare "chaume")
